text:
Sofia: morning async — quick check-in
Sofia: Yesterday: finished the dataset adapter for the cardiology prompt set and ran a first-pass eval on r-instruct-small-v2. Noticed a drop on the 'diagnosis' subset (roughly -6% accuracy).
Sofia: Blocker: can't reproduce the exact drop locally with the same seed; CI run and local run have different tokenization configs.
Tom: saw something similar on the 'legal' prompt set after q4 quantization — perplexity went up for long-form answers. Might be tokenizer or padding differences.
Priya: can you paste the eval diff (small snippet) and the exact job config? pinging @eval-bot for artifact link.
Sofia: diff snippet:
```
- Diagnosis accuracy: 0.78
+ Diagnosis accuracy: 0.72
```
Sofia: CI artifact: gs://redwood-evals/1778459999/sofia/model-v2/eval-report.html
Devon: I'll check tokenization tables and the tokenizer version. Quick test to try: `--use-fast-tokenizer=false` or force the HF tokenizer commit that CI uses.
Marta: FYI I pushed a clarifying edit to the prompt set (cardio-v1) to reduce hallucination on follow-ups. New prompts are in `/datasets/prompt-sets/cardio-v1`.
Priya: Today: reproduce regression end-to-end, run a compare job against v1.7 (no quant), and run q4 and fp16 variants.
Tom: I'll own the quantized perf tests and set up a gating dashboard. If it's model degradation we'll prepare a rollback plan.
eval-bot: Artifact built: s3://evals/1778460100/sofia/v2; CI job #452 — unit tests passed, eval threshold failed on 'diagnosis' subset — timestamp 2026-03-16T12:05Z.
Sofia: assigning follow-ups: @Priya -> replicate + minimal repro; @Tom -> quantized regressions + gating; @Devon -> tokenizer parity + config; @Marta -> prompt tweak review and token-length stats.
Marta: ack :thumbsup: I also noticed the prompt edit increased avg token length by ~6 tokens which could push some requests into the next kernel selection bucket.
Devon: noted — that seq-len change could affect kernel selection and batching behavior. Will check batch/seq boundary heuristics.
Priya: small suggestion for eval infra: include `--seed` and `--tok-config` in job metadata so reproductions are deterministic across CI vs local.
Sofia: agree — @eval-bot can we start stamping those fields into the job manifest?
eval-bot: queued change request to include `seed` and `tokenizer_commit` in job metadata; PR #2304 opened by infra — CI will pick up tomorrow.
Tom: timeline: I can run quant tests by midday PST and try a constrained canary if we find safe rollbacks.
Priya: I'll aim to have a reproducer + root-cause hypothesis by EOD PST. If it's tokenization, Dev will have the fix; if it's model, we'll consider rolling back the deployment.
Sofia: no other blockers from me right now. Thanks everyone — ping if you need GPUs or additional eval credits. :heart:
Marta: one more note — I logged a tiny prompt set regression ticket (CARDIO-112) with examples, linking to the artifact above.
Devon: added a short script to compare tokenization parity: `scripts/compare_tok.py --job-ids 452 450` — pushing to repo now.
Priya: thanks — will run that and attach results to CARDIO-112.
Sofia: great, wrap up: short term workflow — reproduce -> token parity check -> quant vs fp32 compare -> decide rollback or prompt tweak.
Sofia: end of check-in.
